sloka: ता दृशानि अन्या अपि अरण्यानि विचित्य भृइश पीडिताः ।स देशः च दुर्अन्वेष्यो गुहा गहनवान् महान् ॥४-४८-७॥
transliteration: tā dṛśāni anyā api araṇyāni vicitya bhṛiśa pīḍitāḥ ।sa deśaḥ ca duranveṣyo guhā gahanavān mahān ॥4-48-7॥

translations.english: Having searched all over in the forests and very difficult areas, the fearless, invincible vanaras moved forward, leaving that place and entered another areasearching.
